description: This is a Java test class for the DatabaseSpecificSQLGenerator, containing unit tests for its countQueryResult method, which constructs count queries from given SQL statements.

classes.name: DatabaseSpecificSQLGeneratorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DatabaseSpecificSQLGenerator's countQueryResult method, verifying correct count query generation for various SQL inputs.

methods.name: testCountQueryResultOnEmptyString
methods.description: Tests countQueryResult when input SQL is empty string.

methods.name: testCountQueryResultOnSqlWithoutLimitOrOffset
methods.description: Tests countQueryResult on SQL without limit or offset clauses.

methods.name: testCountQueryResultOnSqlWithLimit
methods.description: Tests countQueryResult on SQL with a LIMIT clause.

methods.name: testCountQueryResultOnSqlWithOffset
methods.description: Tests countQueryResult on SQL with an OFFSET clause.

methods.name: testCountQueryResultOnSqlWithLimitAndOffset
methods.description: Tests countQueryResult on SQL with both LIMIT and OFFSET clauses.
